2 cups pecan halves, toasted at 350 for 7min. Or you can toss them in a toaster oven on toast for 4-5min 1/2 cup butter (4 oz) 1 cup light brown sugar (200-210g) 1/2 cup white sugar (100g) 1/2 cup light corn syrup *USE VOLUMETRIC MEASURING CUP * 1/2 tsp fine salt 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp bourbon (or whiskey), you can totally leave this out if you want. 2 tbsp half & half, or you can use milk 3 tbsp flour 3 large eggs + 1 egg yoke

  1. Bake pie shells @ 350 for 20 min. If you have pie weights or spare change laying around, you lay parchment paper over your premade pie shell and pour in the change, glass beads or what ever you can find that will withstand the heat and hold down the shell as it bakes. You will bake for 15min with the parchment/weights, then remove the parchment/weights and bake for another 10 min.

  2. Crack your eggs and leave them in a bowl for later, beat them now.

  3. Toss everything listed besides the pecans and eggs into a pot and bring it to a boil while mixing it

  4. Remove from heat, let mixture cool for 2min

  5. Now we have to pour the mixture into the eggs, but not cook the eggs. This process is called tempering. It's very simple, take your hot sugary mixture and pour in about 2 tablespoons of it into your eggs while mixing them together with a whisk. Repeat this process every 10 seconds until mixture is very brown, then you may start adding in much larger portions of the sugar mixture at once since your eggs are tempered.

  6. Put pecans in the pie shell

  7. Pour mixture over pecans directly into the pie shell. Fill it to the top, like a cup of coffee thats too full, so you take a little sip off the top that will allow you to pick it up and move it. It should be that full.

  8. Make sure all pecans are covered by mixture

  9. Put in the oven for 45min, 40-50min is the average.

That's it.. Pecan pie!!
